notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
We have recently switched to a new game engine for the development of Crownless Abyss. Here's a glimpse of the new and improved battle UI!

This change of engine will allow for improvements including support for higher game resolution, performance, and many more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148001/6c47fb3542a4fd42c4ff1441c35f51c5fa139425.jpg[/img]

Feel free to share your impressions, comments, or feedback. Cheers!
